subject: POC kickoff — aligning hands-on windows across US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@cloudforge.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff and hands-on sessions — availability and constraints

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the overview earlier this week. CloudForge is excited to kick off the POC — we want to validate prompt routing on a bursty production-like workload and run an initial load test against the model variants you recommended.

High-level asks:
- 90 minute hands-on session (prompt review + routing config) with our dev and SecOps teams
- 60 minute load rehearsal (scaled, synthetic traces) 24–48 hours after the hands-on
- One shorter follow-up for regression checks after the rehearsal

Constraints:
- EU stakeholders prefer 14:00–17:00 CEST (afternoon)
- APAC SREs can only do 08:00–11:00 SGT (morning)
- US product folks prefer 09:00–12:00 PT or 16:00–18:00 PT (early morning or evening for other zones)

Can you propose a rotating schedule that keeps the hands-on during EU afternoon on at least one day and gives APAC a morning slot on another? We want at least two zones to have live coverage for the load run.

I've attached a draft agenda and a short list of prompt examples. Also looping Priya for procurement/logistics.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Engineering
CloudForge Analytics

Attachments: POC-agenda-v1.pdf (pdf, 180KB); prompt-set-sample.json (json, 42KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and hands-on sessions — availability and constraints

Sanjay — appreciate the detail.

We can do a rotating schedule that hits EU afternoon and APAC morning across two consecutive days. Proposed plan (all times localized with examples):

Option A (two-day rotation):
- Day 1 (hands-on deep dive): 14:00–15:30 CEST / 08:00–09:30 EDT / 22:00–23:30 SGT (EU primary) — focus: prompt review + routing rules + KV caching
- Day 2 (hands-on + load rehearsal): 09:00–10:30 SGT / 02:00–03:30 CEST / 17:00–18:30 PDT (APAC primary) — focus: live workload replay + scaling tests

Option B (single extended day with split blocks):
- Block 1 (EU-centric, 90m): prompt review + canary routing
- Block 2 (APAC-centric, 60m): load rehearsal (with 30m overlap for handoff)

I'll add internal notes for canary/fallback models so we don't waste your quota in the rehearsal. Calendar poll: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-global-poc — please vote for Option A day-pair or Option B.

Karthik, Mina — can you confirm available slots and whether we should include a separate security questionnaire walkthrough for SecOps?

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 00:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and hands-on sessions — availability and constraints

Logan / Sanjay — quick notes from the infra side:

- For the load rehearsal, we should stage a synthetic trace that mirrors your 95th percentile bursts; recommend target qps 1.5x your observed production peak.
- We'll provision a burst-capable dedicated pool and a fallback (smaller quantized model) so the rehearsal doesn't block other customers.
- Request: can CloudForge share 3 representative prompt traces (anonymized) ahead of the hands-on so we can pre-warm KV cache keys and prepare batching profiles? prompt-set-sample.json is helpful but real traces will make the rehearsal meaningful.

I can join both sessions. Mina — will you own the load configuration and the canary rollout parameters? Monica — please coordinate doc-signing cadence with procurement (Priya).

Thanks,
Karthik
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@cloudforge.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: POC kickoff and hands-on sessions — availability and constraints

Hi all,

Procurement notes:
- We need one week lead time for a purchase order and standard MSSA redlines completed. DocuSign link preferred.
- Security will want a short walkthrough (30m) of audit logs and data retention after the hands-on — can that be scheduled as a separate slot?

Sanjay and I reviewed the calendar poll: Option A (two-day rotation) looks best for internal coordination. If Redwood can do the APAC morning on Day 2, we can staff it. Proposed concrete dates:
- Day 1: Tue, Aug 17, 2027 — EU hands-on (14:00 CEST)
- Day 2: Thu, Aug 19, 2027 — APAC hands-on + load rehearsal (09:30 SGT)

I've attached the procurement checklist and added a DocuSign invite for the MSSA.

Best,
Priya Reddy
Head of Procurement & Vendor Ops
CloudForge Analytics

Attachments: docusign-invite.eml (email invite, 2KB); procurement-checklist.xlsx (xls, 28KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cloudforge.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: POC schedule + pre-reqs (Aug 17 & Aug 19)

Thanks Priya — logging final plan:

- Day 1: Tue, Aug 17, 2027 — 14:00–15:30 CEST (EU primary): prompt review, routing policy configuration, KV cache priming.
- Day 2: Thu, Aug 19, 2027 — 09:30–11:00 SGT (APAC primary): load rehearsal + scaling verification.
- Security walkthrough (30m): Fri, Aug 20, 2027 — flexible, target EU afternoon.

Pre-reqs for CloudForge: anonymized prompt traces (3), expected qps for rehearsal, and a list of endpoints we should hit for the replay. Karthik will provision a burst pool and prepare a safe fallback model.

I've put calendar holds and sent the DocuSign request to Priya. Attaching a short internal runbook (internal only) and a list of who will be on the call from our side.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: internal-runbook-v0.2.txt (txt, 6KB); participant-list.csv (csv, 1KB)

Forwarding the confirmed schedule so ops can lock in provisioning. Key action items:
